text:
Below are four statements about the diffraction of a wave on the surface of water.
Which statement is correct?
A
Diffraction involves a change in the speed of the wave.
B
Diffraction involves a change in the wavelength of the wave.
C
When a wave passes through a gap, its direction changes.
D
When a wave passes through a gap, its frequency changes.

options.label: A
options.text: Diffraction involves a change in the speed of the wave.

options.label: B
options.text: Diffraction involves a change in the wavelength of the wave.

options.label: C
options.text: When a wave passes through a gap, its direction changes.

options.label: D
options.text: When a wave passes through a gap, its frequency changes.
